dedupe_keys.name: gem can autonomous vehicle can bus intrusion traces

description: GEM-CAN records labelled controller-area-network frames from an autonomous GEM e6 vehicle at North Carolina A&T State University’s closed campus track. The release contains about 143,000 frames from normal operation, denial-of-service traffic and controlled brake or steering data tampering. CSV records include timestamps, message identifiers, payload fields and normal or attack labels, with JSON metadata describing conditions. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY-NC 3.0. The article clarifies that attack tests kept the autonomous vehicle stationary for safety. Coverage is one vehicle and controlled test arrangement, with exact dates unestablished. These limitations prevent treating the observations as on-road incident frequencies or general actuation effects. A reviewer-assessed use is testing lightweight detection and bus-load impairment components in vehicle-system resilience simulations. platform-mininet is a related emulation platform at a different network level. No frame archive, control message or attack code was downloaded or executed.
name: GEM-CAN autonomous-vehicle CAN-bus intrusion traces
